correctness.rationale: The monomial intertwiner J sends t^(2j) to t^(2j+2) and fixes odd powers, so it conjugates every derivation operator after adding a trivial one-dimensional summand. This proves Lie bracket and 2-map preservation. The equation D_f²(t)=f f′ gives eg=g²=0, and K[z]/z^s valuations enumerate exactly all allowed g and their annihilator e, with no overlap. The ranks are dimensions of the spans of z^j f; the coefficient sums simplify to the displayed geometric/flat formula. Direct exhaustive F2/F4 operator checks agree, but are explicitly not generalized from finite evidence.

value.rationale: The subject is a canonical sequence of Artinian local algebras and their restricted derivation Lie algebras. Exact parity-invariance of the entire natural representation up to a trivial summand is structural, and the square-zero rank polynomial completely enumerates a natural restricted nilpotent-cone filtration in every finite characteristic-two field. Its geometric low-rank coefficients, constant high-rank plateau and full rank support are mathematically motivated invariants, beyond a normalization or a trivial count.
